Commentary.Commentary: So, Shikhar Dhawan collects the trophy and hands it over to Avesh Khan. The whole team celebrates as they pose for the camera. Now, the focus moves to the shortest format of the game. These two teams will compete for the 5-match T20I series. The first game is on Friday, 29th July at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). Do join us for the build up as well. Till then, goodbye and cheers.

The skipper of India, Shikhar Dhawan says the boys are young but they played brilliantly and the maturity they showed was very good and he is proud of them. States he is pleased with his form, he has been playing this format for a long time and he knows how to bat but at times he falls in the attempt to take a risk but he is fine with it. Credits Shubman Gill for the way he played and it was amazing to watch him play. He thanks the crowd for their support and says he is very grateful.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says it was a tough one for them, they could have won the series too but it did not go their way, they did not happen to show up today but they tried their best and he hopes they can do better the next time. States he felt 257 was chasable but it was going to be a challenge however, early wickets did not help and that is where they lost the game. Ends by saying the youngsters got good exposure and he hopes to go strength to strength from now on and is looking forward to the T20I series before the New Zealand series.

Shubman Gill is the Player of the Match and Player of the Series as well for contributing with his bat throughout the series. He says he wanted to get a ton but it is not in his control but he is pleased with how he played. Adds he was disappointed the way he got out in the first two games and now he wanted to spend time in middle. Admits he wanted to bat just the one over to get to his ton. Reckons the wicket was a good one to bat on but the ball was gripping a bit later on.
Presentation coming up...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, the Indian openers got their side off to a lovely start before rain intervened. It was the Shubman Gill show post the rain break and he deserved a ton. It would have well been one had rain not played a part and cut short the Indian innings. However, the hosts had to chase a target of 257 in 35 overs which they failed to do so comprehensively.

For India, all the bowlers bowled well. Everybody had a wicket to their name apart from Hooda. He though kept it tight and did a handy job. Siraj started the proceedings and took two wickets while Yuzvendra Chahal made sure the lower order doesn't play much. He ended with four wickets. Overall, it was a comprehensive show by the visitors.

The start was disastrous for the hosts as they lost two in one over. Then Shai Hope and Brandon King steadied the ship but Hope fell when it was time to accelerate. Brandon King and Nicholas Pooran then tried to get things on track but whenever Windies looked like getting a move on, they lost a wicket. They needed someone to go big but that wasn’t the case and in the end, they have not even come close to the target.
Quite an easy win in the end for India! 257 runs in 35 overs was never going to be an easy chase and the Windies have fallen well short of it and INDIA HAVE INFLICTED THE WHITEWASH!

OUT! TAKEN! Chahal ends with four wickets! Full ball, flighted and on middle. Seales tries to sweep across but gets a top edge to square leg where Shubman Gill tracks back and takes it. India sweep the series 3-0.
Commentary.Howout: c Shubman Gill b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: On middle. Seales stays back and defends it on the leg side.
Flights one full and outside off, turning in. Seales prods a bit to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. A stifled appeal follows for LBW but not given.
Fuller and outside off. Seales steps across and defends.

OUT! TAKEN! Walsh falls to the trap! Chahal bowls way outside off, fuller and nicely flighted. This one spins back in sharply. Walsh looks to drive as he reaches to it but is late to react. The ball goes off the outside edge nicely into the hands of Shikhar Dhawan at first slip.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off, pushed through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off, drifting in. Walsh tries to slash at it but misses.
Length and on off, dropped to point for one.
Full and slanting on middle. Walsh drives it to mid off and takes a quick single. Hooda misses his shy at the keeper's end.
FOUR! Edged! This is full and outside off. Walsh tries to drive against the angle but gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
A length ball, outside off. Walsh tries to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper who collects it on a bounce. Almost had another one.
Outside off. Holder tries to defend with soft hands. He gets an inside edge onto the pads and it rolls to point for a single.
FOUR! Full and spinning in outside off. Walsh drives it firmly through covers for a boundary.
This one lands way outside off and spins off the rough and into the batter. Walsh is beaten as he tries to block it away.
Slower, full and outside off. Holder pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted full ball, outside off. Walsh drives it to long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent catch by Thakur, it came quick to him! Chahal serves a leggie, full and around leg. Paul tries to reverse hit it. He hits it flat and in the air to point where Shardul Thakur dives to his right and completes the catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Shardul Thakur b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, pushed through point for one.
Fuller and on off, pushed to mid off.
Short in length and on middle. Paul tries to pull but misses and gets hit on the body.
Full and outside off, giuded to point.
Pitched up on middle, eased down to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies seven down now! A cross-seam delivery, it holds on the surface as this is full and on off. Akeal Hosein tries to loft it over mid on but fails to get any distance. It goes high and to mid on where Shikhar Dhawan takes it with ease. He does his trademark thigh-five celebration.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller ball, outside off. Hosein mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, driven to covers for a single.
Bangs a bouncer on middle. Hosein defends it well.
On a length and on off. Hosein leaps as he tries to fend it away but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
On middle, kept out.
Wide! Shorter and down the leg side. Hosein misses his flick.

OUT! TAKEN! Pooran goes now. It is falling apart for the Windies here! Krishna rolls his finger on this length ball, outside off. It is there to be hit as Pooran stays back and tries to pull but it goes off the splice and to mid on where Shikhar Dhawan takes it over his head. Not quite sure what happened as Holder smiles back. The replay shows Holder dropped his bat while Krishna was running in. Might have lost his focus there.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Prasidh Krishna

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off. Holder dabs it to third man for one.
Length and outside off. Holder punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Goes for the slower ball now, full and outside off. Holder looks to drive but misses.
Short ball, outside off, nipping away. Holder looks to pull but misses.
Length ball, outside off. Pooran steers it to point where Patel fumbles and allows a single.
Length ball, slanting on the pads. Pooran misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
A length ball, around off. Pooran looks to drive but gets an inside edge to square leg and he runs across to complete the second run. Good running.
A run to end a good over for the Windies! On the pads, it is pulled to short fine leg.
FOUR! Nice and fine! On the pads, this is tickled fine and this one races away to the fence.
FOUR! They need one every over. A full toss outside off, this is hit through covers for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On off, defended.
Lands well short! On middle, the slog sweep is out, it lands short of deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
Jason Holder comes in.

OUT! TIMBER! Carty falls. The pressure of dots got to him. This wicket though could well be a blessing in disguise for the Windies. He steps out, this is on a length. He looks to slash but not enough room. Gets an inside edge onto the stump.
He needs to play more such shots! On middle, this is worked over mid-wicket for two.
Carty can't find his timing! Shorter and outside off, Carty looks to pull but misses.
Mistimed! Length and outside off, Carty swings but it goes off the inner half to cover.
Carty needs to get a move on now! Short and outside off, he shapes to cut but then lets it be.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Takes a single as he plays it down to long on.
Takes a single! On off, this is hit wide of cover. What will Pooran now do on the last ball?
Make that 4! On off, this is pushed to cover.
Three dots in a row! On off, this is cut to point.
On middle, blocked.
Another dot! Dots will build pressure. Shorter and on off, this is cut to point.
Ends the over well! On middle, kept out.
Good tidy stuff from Shardul! Length and on middle, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Pooran looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
This is what Carty has to do, give the strike to Pooran! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Hit hard but only one! Fuller and outside off, this is hit through covers for one.

DRINKS! Nicholas Pooran plays a key role from here on if the Windies want to win it. Although they have good amount of batting left. The skipper needs to play a key role and take this game deep. India will hope to keep things under control and take wickets at regular basis.
On off, defended.
Pooran will feel he misses out! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Overthrow and a run. On off, this is pushed towards point. The fielder makes a wild throw and a single results in the end.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Shorter and on the pads, this is hit through square leg for one.
FOUR! Runs flowing now. A full toss outside off, this is eased through covers.
FOUR BYES! Windies won't mind how they come as long as they do. That spun. This lands outside off and turns back in. Beats the bat of Carty and goes over middle and down to the fine leg fence.
On the stumps, kept out.
On middle, blocked.
Takes a single now as this is worked through mid-wicket.
SIX! That is huge! Very huge. Pooran steps out out but does not get to the pitch of it. He hits it way over the long off fence.
FOUR! Deft! Shorter and outside off, Pooran waits and guides it past short third man for a boundary.

OUT! TIMBER! That gets through and the stand which was starting to worry India has been broken! Lovely nut. This is tossed up outside off. It drifts it and zips through after landing. King is late in getting his bat down and is cleaned up.
Shorter again, this is pulled through square leg for another single.
On off, pushes it through covers for one.
On middle, defended.
Shorter, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Another run as this is eased down to long on. Hooda continues to keep it tight.
On middle, this is worked down to long on for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Just the one as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
On the pads, King looks to sweep but misses to get hit on it.
Outside off to end. Left alone. Good sensible batting.
FOUR! Fourth in the over. Pooran joins the act! Short and width on offer and Pooran loves it. He cuts it through point. Races away.
Good comeback! A yorker on the pads, it is jammed towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Make that three in a row! King turning it on here! Shorter and outside off, this is guided to the right of point and this one too races away to the fence.
FOUR! This is better! Stand and deliver! Length and on off, this is smashed through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Nicely played. Windies need a few more. Shorter and on off, this is guided past point and the ball races away. Good start to the other. Can they make this into a big on now?
A dot to end! Shorter outside off, it is slapped but to covers.
50 up for the Windies, they need to step on the gas now. On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Fires it through, it is on off, pushed to covers.
Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Was that a chance? Not sure. Pooran comes down the track, this is tossed up wide outside off, he goes after it, it flies off the outer half but seems to have landed short of point.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to cover.
A full toss on middle. Pooran gets off the mark as he drills it to long on for a single.

OUT! STUMPED! Hope goes after doing the repair job but much more was expected from him! Chahal serves a flighted full ball, around off, a leg breaker. Hope pre-meditates as he comes down the track and tries to swing across but misses it completely and Sanju Samson is quick to dislodge the bails.
Commentary.Howout: st Sanju Samson b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, worked through point for a single.
Slower and on leg. Hope drills it down to long on for a run.
Angling on the pads, bunted to square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. King punches it to covers.
Shorter and outside off. Hope bottom edges it as he tries to push, back onto the pads.
Leg bye! On the hips. King fails to tuck it away and it rolls to mid-wicket for a leg bye.
A bumper now, outside off. King tries to ramp it over but fails to connect.
Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a run.
On middle, it is hit to mid-wicket. Hope is not happy as he finds the only fielder there.
Length ball, around off. King pulls it to the right of long on and gets to the other side.
Fuller and on middle. Hope inner edges his drive to mid-wicket.
On off, eased down to long off for one more.
This is short but skids through on middle. King did well to get his bat on it. Hit to covers.
Gives a bit of flight on middle. Hope uses his feet and hits it to long on for a single.
Floated full and outside off. Hope drives it through covers for a brace.
Tossed up on middle, eased down to long off for a single.
Short of a length and outside off. King slaps it through point for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Hope turns it to the right of mid on and takes a sharp single.
On middle on a length. King punches it to deep point for one.
Length and on top of off. King nudges it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! This is full and on middle. King stays back and on drives it past mid on for four.
On middle, it is hit to deep square leg for a single.
Prasidh Krishna is into the attack.
That was very quick! Short and at 143 kph on middle. King had to get big as he blocks this out.
DROP AND RUN! Full and on off, it is pushed to covers for a quick single.
Length and on middle, tapped to point.
SIX! SLAPPED! Anticipates a short ball and Hope gets width here as well. This is outside off and he clobbers it over long off for a biggie.
Short of a length at 136 clicks, on middle. Hope tries to pull but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Length ball, around leg. Hope flicks it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Shorter and outside off, cut straight to covers.
Floated ball, on off. Hope skips down and lofts it over to long off for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! King getting into his elements now! Drifts one full and on middle. King makes room and drives it through covers and it races into the fence.
Tossed up, outside off, it is worked to point.
SIX! KABOOM! This is full and around off, angling on. King slog-sweeps it over long on for a huge six.
Short in length and around off. Hope pulls it in the gap, through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Angles one on middle, it is hit to mid-wicket.
An out-swinger, length and outside off. Hope swings and misses.
Beaten by pace! Length and on the pads, at 141 clicks. Hope is hurried as he blocks it out.
Two taken! Length ball, outside off. Hope guides it through point, past the fielder for a couple of runs.
On a length and around off. Kept out.
Floated ball on off, driven to long off for a single.
A loopy ball, outside off, Hope pushes it straight to point.
This one skids through, length and outside off. Hope dabs it with soft hands and the first slip fielder catches it on a bounce.
Tossed up, around off. Hope guides it to point.
Very full and on middle. King skips down and drives it to covers. A single.
An arm ball, full and on middle. King chips it to the right of the bowler and Patel does well to dive and stop it.
Short of a length and outside off. Hope tries to push it but misses.
West Indies are underway! A huge roar follows from the crowd! Length and outside off. King dabs it to third man for a single.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off and jags away. King looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

OUT! LBW! Double-strike for India! Mohammed Siraj is breathing fire! Serves a length ball, around middle and leg and it nips back in. Brooks is rooted in his crease as he looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. A massive appeal and the finger goes up. Brooks and Hope share a word and think to review but Brooks knew that was plumb right on the middle.. Brandon King walks out to the middle.
Length and on middle. Brooks tucks it to mid-wicket.
Shamarh Brooks walks out.

OUT! TIMBER! That is an absolute beauty from Siraj and it's a dream start for India! Siraj steams in and serves a full ball, around leg, drifting in a bit. Mayers looks to work it away but is late and it brushes his pads before rattling the stumps. Kyle Mayers walks back on a golden duck.
Mohammed Siraj to bowl from the other end.
Hooda again gets this one to drift away. Length and on middle. Blocked out. A maiden to start for Hooda and India.
Fraction short, drifting away, outside off. Hope fails to cut it away.
A bit quicker, full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on middle. Blocked out.
Fuller and outside off. Hope pushes it to the left of the bowler who makes a diving stop.
Tossed up, outside off. Hope chops it to point.
